title: ABBAS MERE BHAI
body:
ABBAS MERE BHAI, ABBAS MERE BHAI

1. JAL JANE KA SAA'MAN HAI YEH SHAM E GHARIBA HAI

2. KYA SOOTE HO SAHIL PER MOU-MOOD KR ZAINAB SE

3. BE-GOORO KAFAN RAN MEIN MAAJAYE KA LASHA HAI

4. BAZOO MEIN RASAN HOGI BE PARDA BAHEN HOGI

5. PYASOU KI KHABER LENE LAUT E NAHIN DARYA SE

ABBAS MERE BHAI
<<DIVIDER>>
6. JALTA HAI MERA SUB GHAR CHEN'TI HAI MERI CHADER
CHEN'TI HAI MERI CHADAR JALTA HAI MERA SUB GHAR

ABBAS MERE BHAI
<<DIVIDER>>
7. TADPAATI NAHI DIL KO KYA YAAD SAKINA KI
KYA YAAD SAKINA KI TADPAATI NAHI DIL KO
KHAATI HAI TAMACHE AB YEH AAP KI SHAIDAYEE

<<DIVIDER>>
8. IMDAD KO ZAINAB KI ABBAS NAHI AAYE
ABBAS NAHI AAYE IMDAD KO ZAINAB KI
ROO ROOKE HASSAN HAR DUM KEHTI RAHI DUKHPAYEE
